name: Alit
abilities: 1-9 pts melee
description: Alits are common tailless two-legged creatures found in the grasslands and ash wastes of Vvardenfell in Morrowind. They are similar to their more powerful cousin, the kagouti, and resemble a disproportionately large walking mouth.

name: Cliff Racer
abilities: 3-8 pts melee
description: Cliff Racers are large flying creatures found throughout Vvardenfell. They are very aggressive and will attack anyone in sight. This can result in swarms of them descending upon the unwary adventurer.

name: Dreugh
abilities: 5-15 pts melee
description: Dreugh are ancient part-human, part-octopus, and part-crustacean sea monsters commonly hunted for their skin (to make armor) and Dreugh Wax from their shells (for its magical properties). Dreugh can be found in high concentrations around Gnaar Mok, around Ebonheart in the waters below the bridge and the caves, in the deepest waters far off the coast of Seyda Neen, and in Koal Cave near Gnisis.

name: Guar
abilities: 1-9 pts melee
description: Guar are the primary domesticated herd animals of Vvardenfell and are not usually aggressive, with the exception of the somewhat rare Wild Guar.

name: Kagouti
abilities: 4-12 pts melee
description: The more powerful relatives of the Alits, Kagoutis are large and aggressive two-legged animals with large tusks.

name: Mudcrab
abilities: 1 pt melee
description: Mudcrabs are small, hard-shelled creatures found on the shores throughout Morrowind. They will only become aggressive when you come into close proximity of them. High concentrations of Mudcrabs can be found along the Bitter Coast near Seyda Neen, Gnaar Mok, Hla Oad and in Khuul. Be careful searching the Diseased Mudcrab bodies, as you may contract Swamp Fever.
lore: This is the famous Mudcrab merchant.

name: Netch
abilities: 10-30 pts melee
description: Netch are large, peaceful creatures resembling airborne jellyfish with the size and disposition of cattle. They are supported by internal sacs of magical vapors. Netch are herded by farmers in peaceful areas, as their hide makes a good quality leather. The female or "betty" Netch is smaller than the male or "bull", but is more easily provoked into aggression, especially in herds where the female-male ratio is kept higher than in the wild for faster breeding. Some bull Netch, however, have a poisonous attack. These creatures are non-aggressive, but can be defensive of their territory during their breeding season.

name: Nix-Hound
abilities: 1-6 pts melee
description: Nix-Hounds are medium-sized predators that have been known to hunt in packs. They may be fast, but they are not very dangerous for medium-level players. They are easily defeated with Marksman weapons.

name: Rat
abilities: 1-2 pts melee
description: Rats are common rodents found throughout Morrowind. There are many variations of rats, though all are weak.

name: Shalk
abilities: 6-18 pts melee
Shalk's Fire Bite - Fire Damage 3-6 pts in 5ft on Touch
description: Shalks are large and slightly aggressive beetles which use magical fire to attack. They can often be found in the Grazelands and in certain dungeons.

name: Slaughterfish
abilities: 1-6 pts melee
description: Slaughterfish are common and aggressive fish found in the waters surrounding Morrowind and in the flooded areas of shipwrecks.

name: Ascended Sleeper
abilities: 25-75 pts melee
Dagoth's Bosom - Drain Fatigue 20 pts for 30 secs on Target
Fire Storm - Fire Damage 1-10 pts in 10ft for 10 secs on Target
Frost Storm - Frost Damage 1-10 pts in 10ft for 10 secs on Target
Paralysis - Paralyze for 5 secs on Touch
Shockball - Shock Damage 2-40 pts in 10ft on Target
Ash-chancre blight disease - Drain Personality 20-40 pts on Self
Ash Woe Blight blight disease - Drain Intelligence 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Willpower 20-40 pts on Self
Black-Heart Blight blight disease - Drain Strength 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Endurance 20-40 pts on Self
Chanthrax Blight blight disease - Drain Agility 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Speed 20-40 pts on Self
description: "The ascended sleepers are distorted, half-human, half-beast creatures transformed by a mysterious force into powerful magical beings. Ascended sleepers are highly intelligent, aggressive, and dangerous. Ascended sleepers are associated in some way with the Devil Dagoth Ur." - Vala Catraso
lore: Ascended Sleepers are distorted half-Dunmer, half-beast abominations created through magic. They are usually associated with Dagoth Ur. They are intelligent, aggressive, and dangerous to all but the most experienced travelers, hurling powerful Destruction spells at their foes. When killed, they leave no corpse except for their skull.

name: Ash Ghoul
abilities: 15-45 pts melee
Spark - Shock Damage 2-20 pts in 5ft on Target
Earwig - Sound 3-8 pts for 5 secs on Target
First Barrier - Shield 10 pts for 30 secs on Self
Ash Woe Blight blight disease - Drain Intelligence 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Willpower 20-40 pts on Self
description: "The ash ghoul is a distorted, half-human, half-beast creature transformed by a mysterious force into a powerful magical being. Ash ghouls are highly intelligent, aggressive, and dangerous. Ash ghouls are associated in some way with the Devil Dagoth Ur." - Vala Catraso
lore: Ash Ghouls are half-Dunmer, half-beast creatures created by the dark magic of Dagoth Ur. Like ash zombies, they appear to be Dunmer who have had their upper faces removed, but a wormlike proboscis grows out of the hollow space. Despite being called "ghouls", these creatures are not undead; the only exception is Dagoth Baler, who is set as "undead" instead of "humanoid".

name: Ash Slave
abilities: 5-15 pts melee
Spark - Shock Damage 2-20 pts in 5ft on Target
Earwig - Sound 3-8 pts for 5 secs on Target
First Barrier - Shield 10 pts for 30 secs on Self
Ash Woe Blight blight disease - Drain Intelligence 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Willpower 20-40 pts on Self
description: "The ash slave is a humanoid creature transformed by a mysterious force into a deranged beast. These creatures are aggressive and dangerous. Ash slaves are associated in some way with the Devil Dagoth Ur." - Vala Catraso
lore: Ash Slaves are deranged humanoid creatures created by the dark magic of Dagoth Ur. Approach with caution, as they will often cast ranged destruction spells at you.

name: Ash Vampire
abilities: 1-100 pts / 10-50 pts / 15-15 pts melee
Hand of Araynys - Damage Health 20-30 pts on Touch, Damage Fatigue 20-30 pts on Touch, Damage Agility 20-30 pts on Touch, Damage Speed 20-30 pts on Touch
Wrath of Araynys - Damage Health 10-20 pts on Target, Damage Fatigue 10-20 pts on Target, Damage Agility 10-20 pts on Target, Damage Speed 10-20 pts on Target
description: "Ash vampires are immortal magical beings of vast powers. Close kin and loyal lieutenants of the Devil Dagoth Ur, they partake of his supernatural vitality." - Vala Catraso
lore: Ash Vampires are formidable creatures created by the dark magic of Dagoth Ur. They serve as the nobility of the Sixth House. Despite being called "vampires", these creatures are not undead, and it is not possible to catch vampirism from them. Unlike other ash creatures, there are no generic ash vampires.

name: Ash Zombie
abilities: 1-20 pts melee
description: "The ash zombie is a humanoid creature transformed by a mysterious force into a deranged beast. Though their skulls are apparently empty, these creatures are nonetheless intelligent, aggressive, and dangerous. Ash zombies are associated in some way with the Devil Dagoth Ur." - Vala Catraso
lore: Ash Zombies are creatures magically created and transformed by the followers of Dagoth Ur, serving as the lowest minions in the legions of ash creatures. They appear to be Dunmer who have had their upper face (eyes and nose) carved out to leave only a hollow space. Despite being called "zombies", these creatures are not undead.

name: Corprus Stalker
abilities: 5-15 pts melee
Regenerate - Restore Health 1-5 pts for 20 secs on Self
description: "Corprus stalkers are the deformed, deranged victims of corprus disease. Aggressive and dangerous, they carry corprus disease, a deadly disease profoundly affecting a victim's mind and body." - Vala Catraso
lore: Corprus Stalkers are deranged and deformed victims of the dreaded Corprus Disease, which has no known cure. Care must be taken when confronting these creatures as they have become incredibly tough owing to the disease. People in Vvardenfell may warn you that you may be infected with Corprus by fighting Stalkers, but this is untrue: the only ways to become infected are during the Sixth House Base quest (an unavoidable outcome) and from Tanusea Veloth.

name: Lame Corprus
abilities: 8-24 pts melee
Black-Heart Blight blight disease - Drain Strength 20-40 pts on Self, Drain Endurance 20-40 pts on Self
description: "The lame corprus is a deformed, deranged victim of corprus disease. Aggressive and dangerous, they carry corprus disease, a deadly disease profoundly affecting a victim's mind and body." - Vala Catraso
lore: Lame Corpruses are deformed and deranged victims of the dreaded Corprus Disease, suffering the advanced stages. The disease heightens their Strength and abilities, making them dangerous foes. Like Corprus Stalkers, people will warn you about the threat of catching Corprus from them. Again, this is not true, though they may infect you with Black-Heart Blight.

name: Atronach
abilities: 7-18 pts melee
Firebloom - Fire Damage 1-25 pts in 10ft for 5 secs on Target
description: Atronachs are powerful elemental Daedra — of flame, frost and storm — summoned by mages and hunted for the salts they leave behind. Despite being made of fire, a Flame Atronach will still take damage in lava and can move through water.
lore: A powerful frost elemental Daedroth which can be summoned by mages or hunted as a source of frost salts. The most powerful atronach; a lightning elemental Daedroth which can be summoned by more powerful magic users.

name: Clannfear
abilities: 6-18 pts melee
description: A fierce, large, lizard-like Daedra which is commonly sought for its heart for use in Alchemy. Strong, but slow, with a speed of 14. The second most common Daedra, after the scamp. Although commonly associated with Mehrunes Dagon, it can be found in other planes of Oblivion.

name: Daedroth
abilities: 12-36 pts melee
Shockbloom - Shock Damage 1-25 pts in 10ft for 5 secs on Target
Poisonbloom - Poison 1-20 pts in 10ft for 5 secs on Target
Third Barrier - Shield 30 pts for 30 secs on Self
Regenerate - Restore Health 1-5 pts for 20 secs on Self
description: (Not to be confused with the singular form for "Daedra", which refers in whole to those et'Ada not ancestral to the Ehlnofey and their descendants)
lore: A bipedal species of Daedra with a large, crocodile-like snout. Daedroths have excellent melee and spellcasting abilities and should be confronted with caution by experienced adventurers only. Their hearts are commonly sought for their magical properties.

name: Dremora
abilities: Armed melee combat in heavy armor
Often summoned as guards and servants
Carries high-quality weaponry
description: Intelligent and powerful war spirits in the service of Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon, Dremora are powerful foes and typically carry a range of high quality weaponry. Traditionally, Dremora are courteous and aware, but in many cases arrogant.

name: Golden Saint
abilities: Weapon (Strength 50)
Dispel - Dispel 100 pts on Self
Shock Shield - Lightning Shield 3 pts for 20 secs on Self
description: These female Daedra are the spawn of Sheogorath and are feared for their combat abilities. They spawn with high-level weaponry and shields, and have the highest soul value of any generic Daedra type. These creatures can be found in tombs, shrines, and wandering the Grazelands. They can also be summoned by Summon Golden Saint.

name: Hunger
abilities: 11-33 pts melee
Disintegrate Armor - Disintegrate Armor 6-25 pts on Target
Disintegrate Weapon - Disintegrate Weapon 6-25 pts on Target
Paralysis - Paralyze for 5 secs on Touch
description: The Hunger is one of the many servants of the Daedric Prince Boethiah and is known to be capable of quickly destroying its opponents' armor and weapons. The hunger uses its long tongue to attack as well as its claws and spells. A summoned hunger can make a useful guardian against a well-armored foe.

name: Ogrim
abilities: 11-33 pts melee
description: Very large, but none too intelligent, Ogrims are servants of the Daedric Prince Malacath. Unlike the other Daedra listed on this page, there are no Summon spells associated with this species.

name: Scamp
abilities: 5-15 pts melee
description: They are immune to unenchanted iron and steel weapons.

name: Winged Twilight
abilities: 15-45 pts melee
description: A female formed Daedra with wings operating as messenger of the Daedric Prince Azura.

name: Centurion Sphere
abilities: 5-15 pts melee
Shock Shield - Lightning Shield 3 pts for 20 secs on Self
description: The Centurion Sphere is relatively common in Dwemer ruins. They may have served as guards or war-machines, as their two "arms" feature a sword and shield. Unlike the other two common types of Animunculi, the Centurion Sphere features a complex "eye" component. This is likely for the purpose of targeting, as it must maintain a high level of control over its more complicated and delicate weaponry. It may also be similar to a gyroscope, in that it aids the construct in keeping balance over the sphere beneath it. When idle, the body can be retracted inside the sphere, with the shield forming the cap. This process is shown in the following animation.

name: Centurion Spider
abilities: 1-9 pts melee
Poisonbloom - Poison 1-20 pts in 10ft for 5 secs on Target
description: The most common mechanical construct found in Dwemer ruins, Centurion Spiders are aggressive, but are the least dangerous of the Animunculi. They consist of a flexible gas-bag which rests upon a metal base, surrounded by six hinged legs. This material, apparently metallic in nature, may be the "Flesh-Metal" mentioned in the Lessons of Vivec. Poison magicks can be fired at enemies from this bag. It is unlikely that these served as war-machines or guards. They could possibly be maintenance constructs, or perhaps household servants. The underside of the Spider is reinforced to prevent damage from the heated lava floor spaces, which could easily warp untempered metals.
lore: Unlike all other existing Dwemer constructs, the Centurion Spiders in the Ald'ruhn Thieves Guild contain souls.

name: Steam Centurion
abilities: 10-30 pts melee
description: The largest and rarest of the Dwemer constructs, the Steam Centurion is designed in the form of an armored warrior. They were most likely produced to be war-machines, as they feature an extendable mace on one arm, which they use predominantly in combat, and on the other a three-fingered hand. The book Ruins of Kemel-Ze implies that the constructs have a weakness to frost and magic attacks, due to the water/steam that drives them. In actual gameplay, however, they are very resistant to magical attacks, frost included.

name: Kwama Forager
abilities: 1-3 pts melee
description: The smallest (and weakest) variation of kwama, the forager is a worm-like creature resembling the head of a kwama warrior or queen. It scouts land and caves, searching for new colonies and prey. Though aggressive, it is not particularly dangerous.

name: Kwama Queen
abilities: 6-18 pts melee
description: The largest of the kwama which produces all of the nest's eggs. There is one kwama queen in every egg mine. They are too large to move and their needs are attended to by kwama workers.

name: Kwama Warrior
abilities: 3-9 pts melee
Kwama Poison - Poison 1-3 pts for 40 secs on Touch
description: Aggressive kwama which protect the nest from invaders. They can be extremely dangerous for low to mid level characters.

name: Kwama Worker
abilities: 1-6 pts melee
description: The primary source of labor in kwama colonies, digging tunnels and attending to the queen and eggs. It is not aggressive unless provoked or blighted.

name: Scrib
abilities: 1-2 pts melee
Paralysis - Paralyze for 6 secs on Touch
description: The larval form of the kwama which is not very aggressive but can paralyze anything that attacks it. Their image is often depicted on banners, denoting that a tavern is nearby. Scribs are some of the creatures that may wake you when resting in the wilderness. Unlike most of those creatures, they won't attack but instead start wandering around the area aimlessly.

name: Ancestor Ghost
abilities: 1-5 pts melee
Ghost Curse - Drain Endurance 5 pts for 30 secs on Touch, Drain Fatigue 10 pts for 30 secs on Touch, Damage Health 1-10 pts on Touch
description: Typically found guarding tombs throughout Morrowind but can also be summoned by mages. The ghost is not particularly tough but it is immune to normal weapons. The spell to summon them refers to them as "Ancestral Ghosts".

name: Bonelord
abilities: 8-24 pts melee
Grave Curse: Speed - Drain Speed 2-4 pts for 60 secs on Target
Second Barrier - Shield 20 pts for 30 secs on Self
description: A revenant that is usually found protecting the tombs scattered throughout Morrowind.

name: Bonewalker
abilities: 4-12 pts melee
Grave Curse: Endurance - Drain Endurance 2-4 pts for 60 secs on Target
Grave Curse: Strength - Drain Strength 2-4 pts for 60 secs on Target
Brown Rot disease - Drain Strength 10 pts on Self, Drain Personality 10 pts on Self
description: Another form of revenant that guards the tombs throughout Morrowind and can be summoned by magic users. Though not as powerful as other undead, the Bonewalker is feared for the terrible curses it can bestow on its foes. The Greater Bonewalker is a more powerful form of this creature which can also be found in graves and tombs throughout Morrowind. Like its lesser cousins, it may bestow powerful and hideous curses, but these effects do not go away, even if you kill them. Both versions also carry the common disease Brown Rot.

name: Dwarven Spectre
abilities: 5-20 pts melee
Frost Bolt - Frost Damage 10-50 pts in 10ft for 2 secs on Target
description: Ghosts of the Ancient Dwemer which can still be found haunting the halls of their ruins. The ghosts are typically sought as a source of Ectoplasm.

name: Skeleton
abilities: Armed melee combat
Skeleton Archers carry bows
Raised by necromancers and restless tombs
description: A common form of undead found guarding graves and tombs throughout Morrowind.

name: Dagoth Ur
abilities: 50-75 pts / 25-100 pts / 60-60 pts melee

Wrath of Dagoth - Damage Health 5-50 pts for 3 secs on Target, Damage Strength 1-3 pts on Target, Damage Speed 1-3 pts on Target, Damage Endurance 1-3 pts on Target, Damage Agility 1-3 pts on Target, Damage Willpower 1-3 pts on Target, Damage Luck 1-3 pts on Target
Divine Abilities ability - Fortify Strength 100 pts on Self, Fortify Attack 50 pts on Self
description: Dagoth Ur, once Lord Voryn Dagoth of House Dagoth, is the immortal god-king of the Sixth House and the Sharmat at the heart of Red Mountain, whose dreaming spreads the divine disease corprus across Vvardenfell.
lore: After the Heart of Lorkhan is destroyed, his Health is reduced to 200. Otherwise, it is constantly reset to 1000 every frame. Additionally, he has an unlimited pool of Magicka. When the Heart is destroyed, his Magicka will be set to 0, leaving him unable to cast spells (though not defenseless, as his melee attacks are still quite strong.) ** Dagoths Ur's resistances change each time the Heart is hit. Before the first hit with Sunder, he has 50% Resist Fire. After Sunder hits, he will have 50% Resist Frost instead. After the first hit from Keening, he will switch to 50% Resist Shock. After the second hit, that will be replaced with a 50 pt Shield spell. After the third hit with Keening, all resistances will be removed.

name: Heart of Lorkhan
abilities: None — an object, not a combatant
Struck by Kagrenac's Tools to sever divinity
description: The Heart of Lorkhan is the sundered heart of the dead trickster god Lorkhan, buried deep beneath Red Mountain. From it the Dwemer Kagrenac drew his power, and from it the Tribunal and Dagoth Ur stole their divinity.

name: Vivec
abilities: 100-400 pts melee
Hand of Vivec - Damage Health 50 pts for 3 secs on Touch, Fire Damage 50 pts for 3 secs on Touch, Frost Damage 50 pts for 3 secs on Touch, Shock Damage 50 pts for 3 secs on Touch
Wrath of Vivec - Damage Health 50 pts on Target, Fire Damage 50 pts on Target, Shock Damage 50 pts on Target, Frost Damage 50 pts on Target
Divine Abilities ability - Fortify Strength 100 pts on Self, Fortify Attack 50 pts on Self
description: Vivec is the Warrior-Poet of the Tribunal, living god of Morrowind, whose divine will alone holds the Ministry of Truth suspended above his holy city.
lore: This is the un-activated form of the Wraithguard artifact.

name: Yagrum Bagarn
abilities: None — a scholar, not a combatant
description: Yagrum Bagarn is the last living Dwemer, a victim of corprus who dwells in Divayth Fyr’s Corprusarium, his body bloated and his memory reaching back to the disappearance of his entire race.
